::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 163,919 people lived in County Wexford, up 9.5% on 2016. It had the 9th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 81% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Wexford was €1,179, the 16th highest of the 26 counties.
:::

## More about County Wexford

- In 2024, disposable income per person in County Wexford was €27,817, the 13th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-income-map.html)
- In 2025, the average price paid for a home in County Wexford was €318,800, the 13th highest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-prices-map.html)
- In 2025, 6.5 new homes were completed for every 1,000 people in County Wexford, the 8th highest rate of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-completions-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 25% of households in County Wexford rented their home, the 13th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/housing-renting-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 15% of people living in County Wexford were born outside Ireland, the 23rd highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/migration-born-abroad-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 37% of people aged 3 and over in County Wexford said they could speak Irish, the 23rd highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/irish-language-speakers-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 28% of people at work in County Wexford worked from home for at least part of the week, the 15th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-work-from-home-map.html)
- At the 2022 census, 77% of people travelling to work in County Wexford went by car, the 7th highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/economy-car-to-work-map.html)
- Half of people in County Wexford live more than 3.8 km by road from a GP, the 7th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-gp-map.html)
- Half of people in County Wexford live more than 23.5 km by road from a hospital emergency department, the 13th furthest of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/health-distance-emergency-department-map.html)
- Forests and woodland covered 6.9% of County Wexford in 2021, the 21st highest share of the 26 counties. [See the map](/charts/environment-forest-map.html)
